_comment: Expectation manifest for test-scope's frozen acceptance-checks.
Enforced repo-wide by scripts/evals-all.mjs on every push and PR.
expect "green" = a past fix that must not regress. MUST exit 0.
expect "red"   = a known-failing check (open concern). MUST exit 0 or 1.
A check file missing from this manifest FAILS the gate.
LOCKED (evals/**): improvement loops may never edit this file.

mutations.why: without the absent-side rule, a manifest new in the range is compared against 'null' and forces run-all even with no dependencies (the 242/249 regression)
mutations.find: if (was === null || now === null) return declaresDeps(f, was ?? now ?? '');

mutations.why: over-correction: treating every added/deleted manifest as no change hides real dependency additions and removals
an added package.json with an empty dependencies {} object declares nothing and must not force run-all
a requirements file holding only comments declares no dependency
a go.mod with only module/go directives declares no dependency
file-count p90 judged again: an honestly broad commit reads as a regression (the 175 -> 176 trap)
info rows get a verdict: file counts count toward worse
compare no longer ranks time and hub-only first
a failed (bailed) run counted as a duration
run-time p90 computed as the median
hub-only tests not summed over the measured commits
hub-only count ignores the hubs ranking (always 0)
a changed file reaches only its own package's related lookup again (the original gap)
mutations.find: if (ws && !deleted.has(file)) addDependents(cfg, ws, sel, file, all);

mutations.why: dependency edges between workspace packages not built: no package has dependents
dependents only one level deep: c (depends on b, not on a) is never reached
a dependent's source alias ignored: exports decide alone, so an aliasing dependent is treated as a dist consumer
mutations.find: via(P, D) { return aliasesSrc(D, P) ? 'src' : P.via; },

mutations.why: dist consumers handed the changed src file, which their graph (stopped at dist) never contains
dist consumption never marks the upstream package for a prebuild
prebuild runs AFTER the tests (the checks-after-tests ordering)

no name-scan fallback: a dependent whose runner cannot resolve selects nothing, silently
mutations.find: const hits = scanTests(ws.root, ws.files, D, tests, names.filter((n) => n !== D.name));
